note.after_visit_summary:
We think you have a sinus infection. Your cold started about 10 days ago, you started to feel better, and then three days ago it got worse with pressure under your eyes, tooth ache, and thick green mucus. You had a fever at home, and your exam shows swollen, red nose lining, thick yellow-green drainage, and tenderness over your cheek sinuses. Your ears, lungs, and vision are fine.

New medicine: doxycycline 100 mg by mouth twice a day for 7 days. Take it with a full glass of water and stay upright for 30 minutes after. Use sunscreen because it can make you sunburn easily. Start fluticasone nasal spray: 2 sprays in each nostril once a day. Use a saline rinse twice a day. You may keep ibuprofen 400 mg up to 3 times a day with food. Stop using Afrin nasal spray, because using it for more than a few days makes congestion worse.

Call us right away or go to the emergency room if you do not start to feel better in 3 days, or if you get swelling around your eye, trouble seeing, a stiff neck, or a very bad headache. Only come back if you are not clearing up. We may call 555-0129 about your medicines. A note for work covering Monday through today will be provided.
